Facts relevant for disposal of the Rule are that the predecessor of the opposite party Nos. 19a) to 1(e) and the opposite party No. 2 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 60 of 1995 in the 4th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka, for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession conceding, inter alia, that while they were in possession in the land of CS Plot No. 66 of mouza Mohakhali they were dispossessed from an area measuring about 2 (two) decimal by the defendant-petitioner. 

 16. Upon identical question of fact in a suit for declaration of title, recovery of Khas possession after demolition of structures raised by the defendant, confirmation of possession and permanent injunction, in the case of Abul Kashem (Md) vs Md Lutfar Rahman reported in 43 DLR (AD) 17, 1990 BLD (AD) 3 a local investigation was held and the report submitted by the advocate commissioner was objected and that the advocate commissioner was examined and cross-examined and that the report was accepted. That acceptance order was unsuccessfully challenged in the High Court Division as well as in the Appellate Division. In the said case law it was held that "the commissioner's report is to be evaluated in the facts of the case on the evidence adduced and the Court has wide discretion in such matter. Mere acceptance of the report should not give rise to any apprehension in the mind of the litigant."
